modules.label: Launch + token commons
modules.authority: account owner in Bound mode; no new sovereign bypass

modules.label: Swap + optional output lock
modules.authority: exact reviewed input and minimum output
modules.economics: local reserve approximation; separate v4 source

modules.label: Consent-based future gift
modules.authority: donor funds; recipient accepts; fixed beneficiary
modules.exit: donor recall until acceptance; permissionless expiry return; no early exit after acceptance

modules.label: Declared-content artifact sale
modules.authority: escrow and two inventory checks
modules.exit: cancel listing; no reversal of completed purchase
modules.limitations: Bounded declared module universe, not discovery of all external liabilities. Local exact hashes differ from contract predicates.

modules.label: Rooms, invitations, historical authorship
modules.authority: personal filters separate from room administration

modules.label: Scoped agent operations
modules.authority: a model's proposal is not spending permission

modules.label: Authenticated remote portals
modules.authority: one authoritative home; remote view does not duplicate spend authority

modules.label: Encrypted rooms
modules.privacy: old members can retain old plaintext

modules.label: Publish, adopt and grant an instrument
modules.authority: Public code is not permission. Seven-day adoption; exact caller, calldata, target, per-call/lifetime ceiling and expiry.
modules.exit: Immediate revocation; custody change invalidates grant.
modules.limitations: Local recipes include the existing action vocabulary. Dedicated onchain router implements swap/direct lock; no arbitrary bytecode or AI executor.

modules.label: Prefunded work and acceptance
modules.authority: Worker accepts a fixed personal reviewer and deadline/refund policy. Selling the NFT does not change either person.
modules.exit: Payment on acceptance or refund after rejection/timeout.
modules.limitations: Human judgment is not verified task correctness. No appeals or automatic compensation. Source stores a deliverable digest; local model additionally binds its edition author.

modules.label: Artifact-owned bonded sell shelves
modules.authority: Item and proceeds held separately; market operating rights follow the artifact.
modules.exit: After fixed bond, return unsold item or withdraw proceeds.
modules.limitations: One fixed-price sell shelf; not a buy wall, two-sided AMM or a whole-artifact exchange. Rehearsal collectibles are fictional.

modules.label: Commitment-aware artifact exchange
modules.authority: Listing commits to known gifts, grants, work, cells, venues and schedules.
modules.exit: Seller refreshes a changed manifest; old buyer review cannot execute.
modules.limitations: New deployments and explicit configuration required. Old immutable accounts and exchanges are unchanged.

modules.label: Strategy-share conversion
modules.authority: Only explicitly funded cell assets; recipient pinned to that cell.
modules.exit: Redeem subject to the underlying strategy; no promise of liquidity.
modules.limitations: Local model is not a live strategy and promises no yield. External vault solvency remains separate.

modules.label: Fixed basket issuance
modules.authority: Round deposits up and redemptions down; measure exact receipts.
modules.limitations: Not the original underfunded Issue implementation. Simplified two-asset basket; source dust has a fixed beneficiary.

modules.label: Matched principal / income study
modules.authority: Proportional recombination of matched pairs including losses.
modules.exit: Return proportional remaining backing; no nominal-principal priority.
modules.limitations: Not separately tradable principal/yield tokens or a live yield market.

modules.label: Negotiated collateralized credit
modules.authority: Named parties, collateral and exact repayment; no oracle or root-NFT pawn authority.
modules.exit: Repay before due; collateral to lender at/after default deadline.
modules.limitations: Not flash liquidity, dynamic liquidation, unrestricted lending or a safety endorsement.

modules.label: Physically covered calls
modules.authority: Full cover at creation; only named holder exercises before expiry.
modules.exit: Writer cancellation before sale; unsatisfied expiry returns cover.
modules.limitations: No naked options, oracle pricing or promised fair premium.

modules.label: Application-edition commitments
modules.authority: Records identify a version; no uploaded program is evaluated.
modules.limitations: A hash is not stored application bytes. Release HTML archive chunks are prepared locally, not deployed.

modules.label: Leveraged markets
modules.authority: No callable financial executor or activation switch in this release.
modules.limitations: Dave source counterexamples remain unresolved for integration; architecture slot is not a completed module.

modules.label: Outcome markets
modules.authority: No callable financial executor or activation switch in this release.
modules.limitations: Dave source counterexamples remain unresolved for integration; architecture slot is not a completed module.

modules.label: Exclusive keeper windows
modules.authority: No callable financial executor or activation switch in this release.
modules.limitations: Dave source counterexamples remain unresolved for integration; architecture slot is not a completed module.

modules.label: Decision journal and general memories
modules.authority: Writing does not authorize a trade. Reflections belong to the original author; NFT sale does not transfer a decryption key.
modules.privacy: Explicit public body or client-encrypted AES-GCM body. Headers and timing are not confidential.
modules.exit: Export a complete archive; keep the passphrase separately. No recovery from the discarded original Seal Memory.
modules.limitations: Browser-tested public local flow and fail-closed crypto availability. Encryption roundtrip tested with native Node Web Crypto; secure-browser encrypted E2E still required. No blockchain deployment.

modules.label: Activity-shaped optical form
modules.authority: A view projection, not account authority, rarity, reputation or financial value.
modules.privacy: No interpretation or display of private words. Optional memory imprint can be omitted; action metadata remain visible.
modules.exit: Compare original or inspect an earlier activity layer without undoing actions.
modules.limitations: History uses the current base genome. Finite visual parameters are not collision-resistant identity. Full protocol-wide onchain event admission, reorg handling and metadata linkage are not implemented.

modules.label: Atomic onchain journaled-swap source
modules.authority: Exact nonce, input, minimum output, deadline, temporary allowance and caller-account recipient.
modules.privacy: Contract stores full public bytes or supplied ciphertext; it receives no decryption key and cannot certify encryption.
modules.limitations: No deployed route or wallet adapter. Narrow source returns output to the account, without the local UI optional output lock. Custodian-at-time is not falsely labeled the human author of an account-triggered operation.
